3\. Manpower Management

* Allocate operators and workers according to production requirements.

* Train employees on production procedures, SOPs, safety practices, and work instructions.
* Monitor employee performance and communicate recurring issues to the production manager.

5\. Production \& Quality Coordination

6\. Machine \& Equipment Coordination

* Identify opportunities to improve production efficiency and reduce downtime.
